component.name: NeoStego
component.summary: Hide files in images and audio and embed invisible watermarks

description.p: NeoStego hides files inside images and WAV audio, optionally encrypted, and embeds invisible watermarks for detecting copies. It provides a Compose desktop interface, an accessible classic interface, and command-line tools.
This community package downloads the official Linux Debian release from ElCruncharino/neostego at install time and runs its unmodified bundle, including the Java runtime.
NeoStego uses its own file choosers (falling back to Swing), not the desktop file portal. Documents and Pictures are accessible to these dialogs. For other folders, grant only the access you need:

ul.li: Audio in Music: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-music io.github.ElCruncharino.NeoStego
Files in Downloads: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-download io.github.ElCruncharino.NeoStego
Undo these grants: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.ElCruncharino.NeoStego

description.p: The command-line interface is available with flatpak run io.github.ElCruncharino.NeoStego --help.
